name: AWSPCA CAPlugin REST Gateway Plugin
description: AWSPCA CAPlugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: RoleArn
ca_plugin_config.description: Destination Role ARN to use for AWS auth. Supports the [profile] prefix when using Default SDK auth, e.g. [myprofile]arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MyRole.

ca_plugin_config.name: Region
ca_plugin_config.description: AWS Region (single region only, e.g. us-east-1).

ca_plugin_config.name: CAArn
ca_plugin_config.description: AWS ACM PCA Certificate Authority ARN. Example: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx

ca_plugin_config.name: S3Bucket
ca_plugin_config.description: S3 bucket name used for PCA audit reports (inventory). The AWS identity in the Role context must have read/write permissions to this bucket.

ca_plugin_config.name: UseDefaultSdkAuth
ca_plugin_config.description: Use AWS SDK default credential inference (supports EC2 instance role, environment variables, shared credentials, etc.). If RoleArn is prefixed with [profile], that profile is prioritized.

ca_plugin_config.name: DefaultSdkAssumeRole
ca_plugin_config.description: If UseDefaultSdkAuth is true, setting this to true will perform AssumeRole into RoleArn using the inferred SDK credentials.

ca_plugin_config.name: UseOAuth
ca_plugin_config.description: Use OAuth OIDC authentication to obtain a token, then AssumeRole into RoleArn.

ca_plugin_config.name: OAuthGrantType
ca_plugin_config.description: OAuth grant type to request (commonly client_credentials).

ca_plugin_config.name: UseIAM
ca_plugin_config.description: Use IAM user access key/secret to AssumeRole into RoleArn.

ca_plugin_config.name: ExternalId
ca_plugin_config.description: Optional sts:ExternalId to supply on AssumeRole calls.

enrollment_config.name: LifetimeDays
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: The number of days of validity to use when requesting certs. If not provided, default is 365
